file_insights.purpose: Handles all reservation-related view logic including CRUD operations and stock information endpoints
key_components: reservations_list: Paginated list view with search and status filtering
reservation_detail: API endpoint returning reservation data as JSON
reservation_create: POST endpoint for creating new reservations with stock validation
reservation_update: PUT endpoint for updating existing reservations
reservation_cancel: DELETE endpoint for soft-deleting reservations
api_materials_with_stock: Helper endpoint listing available materials
api_stock_info: Helper endpoint providing stock information for material-warehouse pairs
imports_used: Database models from inventory and materials apps
datetime and decimal libraries for data handling

patterns_discovered.description: Mix of template-based view (reservations_list) and API endpoints (all others)
patterns_discovered.benefit: Supports both traditional form-based UI and modern API consumption

patterns_discovered.description: Explicit availability checks before creating or increasing reservations
patterns_discovered.implementation: Uses MaterialStock.can_reserve() or direct quantity comparison

patterns_discovered.description: Reservations marked inactive instead of being hard-deleted
patterns_discovered.benefit: Preserves audit trail and historical data

patterns_discovered.description: Tracking creator and updater via reserved_by, created_by, updated_by fields
Consistent date formatting and field mapping for API responses
patterns_discovered.formats_used: Portuguese date format (dd/mm/yyyy HH:MM) and ISO format for dates

patterns_discovered.description: Multiple layers of validation and error handling
patterns_discovered.location: All functions with try-except blocks and null checks

gotchas_discovered.issue: Manual conversion of quantity to Decimal(str(quantity)) suggests floating-point precision concerns
gotchas_discovered.impact: Necessary for accurate financial/inventory calculations but adds complexity

gotchas_discovered.issue: Stock check happens at request time but stock.available_quantity may change between validation and save
gotchas_discovered.impact: Potential race condition in concurrent requests, no transaction-level locking

gotchas_discovered.issue: Prevents updates to expired reservations but no automatic cleanup of expired reservations
gotchas_discovered.impact: Expired records accumulate in database, may need scheduled cleanup task

gotchas_discovered.issue: expiry_date from JSON is passed directly without parsing or validation
gotchas_discovered.impact: Relies on Django ORM to parse, could fail silently with malformed dates

gotchas_discovered.issue: Returns all materials without pagination, could be problematic with large datasets
gotchas_discovered.impact: Performance concern if material list grows significantly

gotchas_discovered.issue: json module imported within functions instead of at module level
gotchas_discovered.impact: Minor style issue, not functionally problematic but inefficient

approach_outcome.implementation_approach: Created a comprehensive reservation management module with full CRUD operations, supporting both traditional and API-based access patterns
key_achievements: Implemented 7 view functions covering complete reservation lifecycle
Added robust stock validation before reservation operations
Provided helper APIs for frontend stock information queries
Implemented pagination for list view (20 items per page)
Added search and status filtering capabilities
Maintained audit trail with user tracking
approach_outcome.scope_completion: All required reservation views implemented in single file

recommendations.recommendation: Add database-level transaction locking or optimistic locking to prevent race conditions in stock reservation
recommendations.rationale: Current implementation has gap between stock validation and save in concurrent scenarios
recommendations.implementation_suggestion: Use select_for_update() or implement version field with optimistic locking

recommendations.recommendation: Add explicit date parsing and validation for expiry_date parameter
recommendations.rationale: Malformed dates could cause silent failures or unexpected behavior
recommendations.implementation_suggestion: Parse dates with try-except using datetime.strptime() before ORM assignment

recommendations.recommendation: Move json import to module level
recommendations.rationale: Standard practice and minor performance improvement
recommendations.implementation_suggestion: Add 'import json' at top of file with other imports

recommendations.recommendation: Create management command for automatic cleanup of expired reservations
recommendations.rationale: Prevents database bloat from accumulating inactive records
recommendations.implementation_suggestion: Add scheduled task to soft-delete reservations past expiry_date

recommendations.rationale: Prevents performance issues as material catalog grows

recommendations.recommendation: Add docstring parameters documenting API request/response schemas
recommendations.rationale: Improves developer experience and reduces integration errors
recommendations.implementation_suggestion: Use Django REST framework style docstrings with @param and @return documentation

recommendations.recommendation: Add unit tests for edge cases like concurrent reservation updates and stock exhaustion
recommendations.rationale: Complex business logic warrants comprehensive test coverage
recommendations.implementation_suggestion: Create test_reservation_views.py with TestCase classes for each view
